messages:
Ravi (People Ops): Heads-up: candidate Marisol (SWE) in CDMX asked for a 6pm CDT interview because of current job. She also requested a Spanish interpreter for behavioral + culture questions. Can we arrange?
Araceli (Recruiter): Marisol prefers 18:00 CDT on Wed. Diego, can panelers do 15:00 PT (same time)? We have 3 engineers and a PM; two are bilingual.
Diego (Hiring Manager): 15:00 PT works for me and the PM. Two ICs can join but prefer 16:30 PT. Can we split into two blocks?
Ravi (People Ops): Splitting is fine. Proposed flow: 18:00-18:40 CDT technical (in English), 18:40-19:10 break + take-home, 19:10-19:50 behavioral with interpreter present, 19:50-20:00 internal debrief.
Araceli (Recruiter): Interpreter note: Marisol asked for Spanish for behaviorals only. Expense check: @ExpenseBot can we preapprove up to $120 USD for a certified interpreter?
ExpenseBot: Auto-check: certified interpreter for local hire approved up to $150 USD per policy. Please provide vendor invoice for reimbursement.
Diego (Hiring Manager): Great. For the technical session, will the candidate use personal machine or loaner? She asked for a loaner Mac (Intel) due to Node env. @ITAssetBot?
ITAssetBot: Reserved 1x MacBook Pro (Intel) from US pool. Loaner ID: LOAN-US-4421. Pickup at Reception on interview day. Return label included.
Ravi (People Ops): Accessibility/dietary: Marisol requested a quiet room and a halal/vegetarian snack option. Facilities, can we prep?
FacilitiesBot: Quiet room reserved (HQ West, Room C5). Halal/vegetarian snack and bottled water will be in the room. Guest parking code: K9-02.
Araceli (Recruiter): Logistics to candidate (DM draft): "Confirming Wed 18:00 CDT (15:00 PT). We'll split the loop; interpreter will join the behavioral segment. NDA via DocuSign required before the take-home task. Loaner reserved for pickup at reception. Reimbursement: local transit up to $50 USD with receipts; interpreter and other approved expenses covered per policy." Approve?
Ravi (People Ops): Approve. Note: transit policy for local candidates caps at $50; interpreter covered separately. Please ask candidate for phone + local ID for pickup.
Araceli (Recruiter): Sent DM. Candidate replied: phone +52 1 55 6789 0123, will bring ID, accepts split schedule. NDA signed within 30m.
CalendarBot: Draft invite below 

```
Title: Redwood Final Loop  Marisol (SWE)
When: Wed 18:00-20:00 CDT / 15:00-17:00 PT
Where: Zoom (interpreter joins for behavioral) + Reception loaner pickup (LOAN-US-4421)
Agenda: 18:00-18:40 Tech (screen share), 18:40-19:10 Break & take-home task, 19:10-19:50 Behavioral (Spanish interpreter present), 19:50-20:00 Panel debrief (internal)
Notes: Quiet room requested. NDA signed; take-home repo link to be sent after 18:40. Transit reimbursement up to $50 (receipt required). Interpreter vendor pre-approved. Parking code K9-02. Candidate phone +52 1 55 6789 0123.
Zoom: https://zoom.redwood.example/marisol-final
```
Diego (Hiring Manager): Please ensure the private repo link expires in 6 hours. Also set candidate-facing calendar in Spanish copy as well.
Ravi (People Ops): Will do. After the loop remind panel to submit Greenhouse scorecards within 24h and to note interpreter observations separately. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
